spans.s: इंग (II) m. 1. A hint or sign; 2. an indication of a sentiment by gesture.
इंगन n. 1. Shaking; 2. an indication of a sentiment by gesture.

इंगित n. 1. Palpitation; 2. intention, purpose (इंगितं हृद्गतो भावः), अगूढसद्भावमितींगितज्ञया K.S.v.62; 3. motion of. the various parts of the body as indicating the intentions, आकारैरिंगितैर्गत्या … लक्ष्यतेऽन्तर्गतं मनः M.viii.26; 4. gestures suited to internal feelings.
इंगित-कोविद, -ज्ञ a. skilled in the interpretation of internal sentiments by external gestures.
इंगित-कोविद, -ज्ञ a. skilled in the interpretation of internal sentiments by external gestures.
इंगुद m. Name of a tree. (Also written इंगुदी, e.g. इंगुदीपादपः सोऽयम् Ut.i.).
